visual_observation.observation: A dark rigid vehicle component overlaps the upper edge and code area of the roof AprilTag in the retained crops, especially frames 520, 550, and 565.

verified: The full-frame brightness and Laplacian-variance measurements do not show a global camera blackout or a sharpness collapse across frames 500-565.
The retained tag crops visibly contain a dark component crossing the tag area during the long detector gap.
The production replay has a 56-frame missed interval across frames 510-565, and the tested full-frame controls also fail through most of that interval.
flow_short2 supplies 99 short predictions but does not increase tag_decode_ratio.
inference: Physical overlap of the component with the tag is a plausible contributor to the long rejection interval.
The current evidence does not isolate physical overlap from tag print quality, perspective, exposure, or rolling-shutter effects.
insufficient_evidence: No matched run has tested the same motion after moving or replacing the tag mount.
No production detector or firmware change is justified.
No B3 observation pass or real A/B eligibility is established.

decision.offline_blocker: The recorded input contains a likely physical visibility/occlusion problem that code-only replay cannot recover reliably.
decision.next_interface: Correct tag visibility or mounting, then retain a matched 1080p motion run before requesting another hardware test.
